goal: Add a reliable fail-closed Warlock meleeRange criterion backed by native selected-target distance/combat-reach observation for WoW 1.12.1 build 5875.
notes: Native/shared runtime change intentionally routes fail-closed to STANDARD. Supports short LazyScript bits meleeRange/notMeleeRange plus Warlock ifTargetInMeleeRange/ifNotTargetInMeleeRange. Missing or stale native samples fail closed for both positive and negative criteria. No gameplay action is dispatched by the observer.
